subject: Fwd: Rapid evidence handover request — timeline & scope clarification
messages:
From: Maria Garcia <maria.garcia@finexcorp.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: security@finexcorp.com
Date: 2027-12-05T15:14:00Z
Subject: Potential customer data exposure — initial evidence and ask

Hi Priyom,

We detected anomalous access patterns in our logs that affect a subset of requests routed through Redwood on Nov 28–30. Our security team pulled a preliminary manifest and uploaded hashes for the files we believe are impacted. We need to confirm Redwood's incident notification obligations under the DPA and request an expedited evidence handoff (forensic export + clock-synced logs).

Specific asks:
- Confirmation of when Redwood became aware and which model/service/region was involved.
- A PST export of request/response metadata (token-level not required) for the impacted window, plus any KV-cache related metadata you can provide.
- A certifying statement about whether plaintext customer texts were stored in logs/backups.

Attachments: forensic_manifest.csv (list of sample request IDs and timestamps).

We appreciate a target timeline for the handoff — FinexCorp's legal team expects evidence to be accessible within 72 hours from acknowledgement per our contract to meet regulatory timeboxes.

Thanks,
Maria Garcia
Head of Security Operations
FinexCorp
[Attachment: forensic_manifest.csv (text/csv)]

---

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Maria Garcia <maria.garcia@finexcorp.com>, security@finexcorp.com
Date: 2027-12-05T16:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Potential customer data exposure — initial evidence and ask

Laura / Ben — looping you in to coordinate the response and confirm obligations under FinexCorp's DPA. Quick summary of required steps from infra/forensics and legal:

1) Triage: validate Finex's manifest against our ingress logs and model routing table for Nov 28–30.
2) Evidence packaging: produce an export that includes request IDs, timestamps, model variant, region, and whether any request payloads were captured in persistent logging/backups. We should avoid sending raw customer payloads unless legally required.
3) Transfer method & auth: Finex asked for a PST-style export; recommend SFTP with ephemeral creds or an encrypted share in our secure evidence bucket.
4) Timeline: Finex requested 72 hours from ack. If we can commit to a partial export (metadata and hashes) within 48 hours and delivery of any deeper exports under an approved EULA/LOA within 7 days, that may be acceptable.

Ben — can you confirm forensic ETA and preferred transfer mechanism? Laura — can Legal draft a short certifying statement about retention and backups (yes/no) we can include with the export? I'll acknowledge to Finex once we have those two points.

Best,
Priyom Das
Product Security Lead
Redwood Inference

---

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Maria Garcia <maria.garcia@finexcorp.com>, security@finexcorp.com
Date: 2027-12-05T19:28:00Z
Subject: Re: Potential customer data exposure — initial evidence and ask

Priyom / Laura / Maria — quick technical update from forensics:

- We matched 62 request IDs from Finex's manifest to our ingress logs; all map to a hosted routing pool (us-west-2).
- No raw request payloads were found in long-term backups. Short-lived diagnostics traces contained snippets for ~7 requests (debug-level traces) — we'll flag those explicitly.
- Recommended handoff: create a time-bounded, encrypted evidence bundle in our secure S3 partition with an object-level manifest and signed hashes. Provide Finex with an expiring presigned URL + one-time token exchange (we'll rotate keys after transfer).

ETA:
- Metadata & signed-hash manifest: 36 hours from ack (target: 2027-12-07T03:00:00Z).
- Full export (if requested and covered by LOA/Evidence Transfer Agreement): up to 7 calendar days depending on legal approvals.

I will prepare the manifest and set up an evidence bucket today. Maria — if you need a narrower export (only IDs + timestamps) we can do that faster.

Attachments: evidence_export_instructions.pdf (transfer steps and accepted formats).

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Incident Response Lead, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: evidence_export_instructions.pdf (application/pdf)]

---

From: Maria Garcia <maria.garcia@finexcorp.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, security@finexcorp.com
Date: 2027-12-06T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Potential customer data exposure — initial evidence and ask

Thanks Ben — that aligns with FinexCorp's needs. Two clarifying items before you prepare the bucket:

1) Scope: please include the KV-cache metadata for the matched request IDs (timestamped key IDs, not payloads). That helps our correlation.
2) Cert: Finex legal needs a short signed statement from Redwood confirming whether any plaintext customer data was retained in backups beyond 24 hours during the relevant window. A yes/no plus short explanation is sufficient; we'll attach it to our regulatory filing.

If you can confirm the 36-hour metadata delivery and provide the S3 presigned link with the token exchange procedure, we will stand up a Finex SFTP client to pull the bundle and acknowledge receipt upon download.

Appreciate the quick coordination — please mark this as high priority.

Best,
Maria Garcia
Head of Security Operations
FinexCorp
